hero.title: Los Lagos Hotel
hero.subtitle: A family-run hotel in the heart of El Calafate, a 3-minute walk from downtown. We welcome you like family and help you plan your glaciers, boat trips and excursions across southern Patagonia.

about.title: A quiet base for exploring southern Patagonia.
about.paragraph: We are a small family-run hotel in an exceptional location, just a 3-minute walk from the town centre, bars, restaurants and travel agencies. A place that combines simplicity, warmth, comfort and attentive, personalised service.

rooms.title: Double or triple, standard or superior.
rooms.paragraph: 4 room types with heating, Wi-Fi, TV and breakfast included. Choose the one that best suits your trip.

experiences.title: The Perito Moreno glacier, within your reach.
experiences.paragraph: We are your base camp in El Calafate. The hotel arranges transfers and helps you plan every excursion across Patagonia.

whyDirect.title: Book direct and get everything we are.
whyDirect.paragraph: You deal directly with the family that runs the hotel: the best rate, homemade breakfast and real help planning your trip across Patagonia.

bestRate.title: Best rate, no commissions
bestRate.text: You get the lowest price right here, dealing directly with the hotel.

breakfast.title: Homemade breakfast included
breakfast.text: Every rate includes our homemade breakfast to start the day right.

excursions.title: We help with your excursions
excursions.text: We arrange glaciers, boat trips and transfers, and help you make the most of every day.

personalCare.title: Personal care, around the clock
personalCare.text: Talk to us directly on WhatsApp, with 24-hour reception every day of the year.

location.title: In the heart of El Calafate.
location.paragraph: Just a 3-minute walk from Av. del Libertador and steps from Lago Argentino. The perfect starting point for the Perito Moreno Glacier and all of southern Patagonia.

cta.paragraph: Book direct with the Los Lagos family: the best rate, breakfast included and a hand planning your glaciers and excursions.
